newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Empaq may merge with Moderna subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Empaq may merge with Moderna subsidiary.

text.p: Mexico's Empaques Ponderosa, a major packaging firm also known as Empaq, will propose to its stockholders the merger with a subsidiary of tobacco and vegetable seed giant Empresas La Moderna, the companies announced on Wednesday.

Shareholders would be presented "a proposed merger by virtue of which Empaques Ponderosa SA de SV as the merger entity will merge Servicios Especializados Tecnico Administrativos SA de CV as the merging entity," a joint notice said.

The notice to shareholders also said that Servicios Especializados, which controlled by La Moderna, has no liabilities and has an asset base comprised of 99.99 percent of the shares of Aluprint SA de CV.
Aluprint makes printed packaging materials for various uses.
The terms of the proposed merger will be announced in respective shareholder meetings on December 16.
